row.title_en: A new model co-designs quantization, compressed attention and draft training
row.summary_zh: 官方首发说明：280B总/14B激活，43层中37 HCA+6 MLA-DSA；默认routed experts为MXFP4(W4A8) QAT，其余权重FP8，KV FP8，indexer cache可MXFP4。
row.summary_en: The official launch describes 280B total and 14B active parameters, with 37 HCA and 6 MLA-DSA layers among 43 layers. Default routed experts use MXFP4 W4A8 QAT; other weights are FP8, KV is FP8, and the indexer cache can use MXFP4.
row.scope_zh: post-training假量化对齐推理粒度/scales/rounding；压缩注意力、稀疏索引及低秩cross-head mix与kernel融合协同；DSpark为另一加速层。
row.scope_en: Post-training fake quantization aligns inference granularity, scales and rounding. Compressed attention, sparse indexing and low-rank cross-head mixing work with fused kernels; DSpark provides a separate acceleration mechanism.
row.dependencies_zh: 插件绑定官方vllm==0.32.0；1.4×是indexing/prefill索引路径指标，不能改写成模型E2E 40%收益。
row.dependencies_en: The plugin binds to the official vllm==0.32.0 wheel. The 1.4× figure concerns indexing/prefill indexing, not a forty-percent end-to-end model gain.
row.boundary_zh: 混合模型总收益不能归于单个QAT；W4A8此处是MXFP4而非INT4，A8编码未在所录段落全局单列。
row.boundary_en: The hybrid model's total gains cannot be attributed to QAT alone. W4A8 here means MXFP4 rather than INT4; the selected passages do not separately specify the global A8 encoding.

row.summary_en: MegaMoE gains NVFP4 W4A16 and SiTU support. Compressed-tensors NVFP4 W4A4 linear layers can explicitly select FP4 Marlin on SM100.
row.scope_zh: 分别处理权重低比特/高精度激活和权重激活同时低比特；格式配置、全局scale次序和内核布局共同决定正确性。
row.scope_en: Weight-only low precision with higher-precision activations differs from low-precision weights and activations together. Format configuration, global-scale ordering and kernel layout jointly determine correctness.
row.dependencies_zh: W4A4路线要求--fp4-gemm-backend marlin及SM100；对应 #44213；W4A16 #44036。
row.dependencies_en: The W4A4 path requires --fp4-gemm-backend marlin and SM100, as described in #44213. The W4A16 item is #44036.
row.boundary_zh: 不把NVFP4检查点统称为W4A4，不用另一FP8融合实验替代其性能证据。
row.boundary_en: Do not label all NVFP4 checkpoints W4A4 or substitute performance evidence from a separate FP8 fusion experiment.

row.summary_en: New mm_bf16_fp8/mm_fp16_fp8 operators multiply BF16 or FP16 activations by FP8 E4M3 weights in [N,K] layout with one FP32 scale, dequantizing the weights inside the kernel.
row.scope_zh: W8A16混合精度计算，保持16位激活，量化对象明确为权重。
row.scope_en: W8A16 mixed-precision computation keeps activations at sixteen bits; weights are the quantized object.

row.dependencies_en: H100 sm_90a, B200 and B300; CuTe DSL compiles on first use and requires caller-provided output and workspace buffers.
row.boundary_zh: 不写成INT8，也不写成FP8 W8A8。
row.boundary_en: Do not describe this as INT8 or FP8 W8A8.

row.boundary_en: Do not extend the guarantee to all backends or dtypes, or treat bitwise consistency as task-accuracy evidence.

row.date_locator: Official published_at and named release sections; Highlights / Quantization and MoE; Features; #20507, #20540
row.title_zh: 昇腾动态W4A8：INT4权重与逐token INT8激活；950DT的FP8 indexer缓存与A2/A3的INT8 QSFA分列
row.title_en: Dynamic W4A8 on Ascend: INT4 weights and per-token INT8 activations / Separate the 950DT FP8 indexer cache from A2/A3 INT8 QSFA
row.summary_zh: 候选版加入ModelSlim W4A8 Dynamic Linear，原文明确INT4 weights和per-token INT8 activation quantization；另修正MXFP打包尾部mask。 950DT的GLM-5.3-Flash CANN KeyPool增加可选FP8 Lightning Indexer key-cache；A2/A3优化INT8 QSFA。
row.summary_en: The release candidate adds ModelSlim W4A8 Dynamic Linear, explicitly using INT4 weights and per-token INT8 activation quantization. It also fixes MXFP packed-store tail masking. GLM-5.3-Flash CANN KeyPool on 950DT gains an optional FP8 Lightning Indexer key cache. A2/A3 receive INT8 QSFA optimizations.
row.scope_zh: 将离线权重表示与在线动态激活量化接入Linear执行路径。 量化对象是indexer key-cache/稀疏索引路径，不能代称整个主Attention KV缓存均为FP8。
row.scope_en: The Linear execution path combines the offline weight representation with online dynamic activation quantization. Quantization applies to the indexer key cache or sparse-indexing path. It does not establish that the entire main-attention KV cache is FP8.
row.dependencies_zh: 硬件/模型按release的model-support表和相应教程逐一核对；该说明不是310P全栈支持声明。 950DT、GLM-5.3-Flash、CANN KeyPool、可选FP8；A2/A3则为INT8 QSFA。
row.dependencies_en: Check each hardware/model combination against the release model-support table and its tutorial. This item is not a statement of full-stack 310P support. The optional FP8 item is specific to 950DT, GLM-5.3-Flash and CANN KeyPool. The A2/A3 item concerns INT8 QSFA.
row.boundary_zh: 候选版不同于稳定版；不能把INT4/INT8和W4A8-MXFP、W8A8-MXFP8混写。 indexer缓存格式、主KV格式、注意力算子输入应分别标注；不是型号间可直接转移的支持证明。
row.boundary_en: A release candidate differs from a stable release. INT4/INT8 must not be conflated with W4A8-MXFP or W8A8-MXFP8. Distinguish the indexer-cache format, main KV format and attention-operator inputs. This does not establish support transferable between product models.

row.date_locator: Official published_at and named release sections; Before you upgrade: QuTLASS / fp_quant removed; Marlin W4A8 removed
row.title_zh: 低比特后端会被替换：Marlin W4A8 迁到 Humming；KV能装更多，可能来自配额回收
row.title_en: Low-bit backends change: Marlin W4A8 moves to Humming / A larger KV capacity can come from reclaiming the allocation budget
row.summary_zh: v0.34.0移除Marlin W4A8与QuTLASS/fp_quant；前者改用humming及新的输入量化配置。 默认在图捕获和warmup之后按实际空闲显存分配KV池，默认块大小从16改64。
row.summary_en: v0.34.0 removes Marlin W4A8 and QuTLASS/fp_quant. The former moves to Humming with a new input-quantization configuration. The default now allocates the KV pool from memory actually free after graph capture and warmup. The default block size changes from 16 to 64.
row.scope_zh: 模型格式、模型加载器与实际执行核之间存在独立接口；发布版可改变这一映射。 回收预估与实际使用之间的差额；这是缓存容量配置，未改变每个KV值的编码位宽。
row.scope_en: Model formats, loaders and execution kernels have separate interfaces; a release can change the mapping between them. The allocator reclaims the difference between estimated and actual memory use. This changes the cache allocation budget without changing the encoding bit width of each KV value.
row.dependencies_zh: 按Before you upgrade表中的配置迁移；不能把所有W4A8文件视为可互换。 容量例与TPOT范围来自不同发布说明汇总，不拼成单一实验。TPOT范围注明concurrency128。
row.dependencies_en: Follow the configuration migration in the Before you upgrade table; W4A8 files are not necessarily interchangeable. The capacity example and the TPOT range summarize different release-note observations and must not be combined into one experiment. The TPOT range is stated at concurrency 128.
row.boundary_zh: 移除fp_quant后原检查点不再直接加载；Humming兼容范围仍需按模型和设备核对。 不能将缓存token容量增加解释为量化率提升；需要同时检验长尾时延。
row.boundary_en: Existing fp_quant checkpoints no longer load directly after its removal. Humming compatibility still needs to be checked for each model and device. More cached tokens do not establish a better quantization ratio; tail latency also needs to be checked.

row.date_locator: Official published_at and named release sections; v0.5.8 Highlights; Features & Integrations; #5713, #6125, #5871, #5875
row.title_zh: 共享KV的关键开始从搬运转向身份一致性
row.title_en: Shared KV depends increasingly on consistent cache identity
row.summary_zh: 增强model revision、LoRA、request tag与TP KV驻留的cache identity；TP group的replicated KV只存一份，保留末尾partial chunk。
row.summary_en: Cache identity is strengthened across model revisions, LoRA adapters, request tags and tensor-parallel KV residency. Replicated KV is stored once per TP group, and the final partial chunk is retained.
row.scope_zh: 用稳定身份和副本消除实现正确复用，并为token-dropping请求引入resident-length-aware allocation与安全prefix publication。
row.scope_en: Stable identity and duplicate-copy removal enable correct reuse. Token-dropping requests gain resident-length-aware allocation and safer prefix publication.
row.dependencies_zh: 必须绑定模型版本、adapter、布局和KV group；部分功能属于新multiprocess运行时。
row.dependencies_en: Bind model revision, adapter, layout and KV group. Some functionality belongs to the new multiprocess runtime.
row.boundary_zh: 不能把缓存复用等同于改变KV数值表示；不同模型/LoRA不能仅按token串共用。
row.boundary_en: Cache reuse does not change the KV numerical representation. Token strings alone do not justify sharing between different models or LoRA adapters.

row.date_locator: Official published_at and named release sections; Key Features and Enhancements / Quantization
row.title_zh: NVFP4权重在Hopper/Ada上以W4A16运行；低精度KV开始按冷热页面组织
row.title_en: NVFP4 weights run as W4A16 on Hopper and Ada / Low-precision KV is being organized around hot and cold pages
row.summary_zh: 通过Marlin增加NVFP4 weight-only W4A16，使相关检查点可在Hopper和Ada Lovelace运行；同版另有MXFP8 W8A8 Linear/MoE。 KVCM V2增加TriAttention、NVFP4 cold-page compression、NVFP4 KV与disk cache；多数模型默认启用V2。
row.summary_en: Marlin adds NVFP4 weight-only W4A16 execution, allowing the corresponding checkpoints to run on Hopper and Ada Lovelace. The release separately adds MXFP8 W8A8 Linear/MoE support. KVCM V2 adds TriAttention, NVFP4 cold-page compression, NVFP4 KV and disk caching. V2 is enabled by default for most models.
row.scope_zh: 低比特存储可通过专用混合精度内核在没有同一原生格式峰值的设备上执行。 将低比特KV表示与页面生命周期/缓存层级结合，区别冷页压缩与热页计算。
row.scope_en: A specialized mixed-precision kernel can execute low-bit stored weights on a device without the same native-format peak arithmetic capability. Low-bit KV representations are combined with page lifecycles and cache tiers, distinguishing cold-page compression from hot-page computation.
row.dependencies_zh: NVFP4 W4A16+Marlin+Hopper/Ada；MXFP8 W8A8是另一配置，不能互相替代。 逐模型检查KVCM V2与KV-cache dtype；不能从总体feature列表推出每个模型可组合所有功能。
row.dependencies_en: NVFP4 W4A16 with Marlin on Hopper/Ada and MXFP8 W8A8 are separate configurations and cannot substitute for one another. Check KVCM V2 and the KV-cache dtype for each model. A combined feature list does not establish that every feature combination works on every model.
row.boundary_zh: 能运行NVFP4检查点不等于设备拥有原生FP4张量算力。 TriAttention、cold-page量化、磁盘offload不是一个机制；不能把组合收益归为NVFP4单独贡献。
row.boundary_en: Running an NVFP4 checkpoint does not establish native FP4 tensor-compute capability on the device. TriAttention, cold-page quantization and disk offload are distinct mechanisms. Combined gains cannot be attributed solely to NVFP4.

row.summary_en: The release notes include fixes to Ascend inference INT4/INT8 dequantization and HybridEngine rollout KV sizing under AutoTP.
row.scope_zh: 修复运行时表示还原与缓存预算，性质是正确性维护。
row.scope_en: The changes fix runtime reconstruction of numerical representations and cache budgeting; they are correctness maintenance.
row.dependencies_zh: NPU条目 #9043；不由这一修复推定所有昇腾型号支持INT4峰值运算。
row.dependencies_en: The NPU item is #9043. This fix does not establish native INT4 peak arithmetic support across all Ascend product models.
row.boundary_zh: 不能将bugfix包装成新量化算法或精度提升。
row.boundary_en: A bug fix should not be presented as a new quantization algorithm or a model-quality improvement.

row.date_locator: Official published_at and named release sections; Figure1; DRAM only buffers writes and stages reads; Limits; Appendix / Hardware and topology, Workloads
row.title_zh: 同容量NVMe池可接近DRAM，但不代表无代价
row.title_en: An equal-capacity NVMe KV pool can approach DRAM, with conditions and costs
row.summary_zh: 官方实测1.8TB NVMe KV pool与同容量DRAM池：Kimi-K3在48/70/96并发、带64GB写缓冲时吞吐相差1%以内。
row.summary_en: Official Kimi-K3 measurements compare a 1.8 TB NVMe KV pool with an equal-capacity DRAM pool. Throughput stays within one percent at 48, 70 and 96 concurrent sessions when a 64 GB write buffer is present.
row.scope_zh: 内容寻址缓存保留前缀并异步加载；NVMe额外读取时间可被繁忙prefill排队覆盖，而不是量化每token的KV。
row.scope_en: A content-addressed pool retains prefixes and loads them asynchronously. Busy prefill queues can hide additional NVMe read latency; the method does not quantize each KV token.
row.dependencies_zh: 1P1D共16 MI355X，TP8 prefill+TP8 decode，Kimi-K3 DCP8；FP8 KV；DSpark 4 draft、synthetic acceptance length3.36；AgentX回放；NVMe两个Micron7450 PRO每节点，64GB DRAM写缓冲+16GiB读staging。
row.dependencies_en: A 1P1D setup has sixteen MI355X GPUs: TP8 prefill and TP8 decode, with Kimi-K3 DCP8. It uses FP8 KV, DSpark with four draft tokens and synthetic acceptance length 3.36, and AgentX replay. Each node has two Micron 7450 PRO NVMe drives; the NVMe path has a 64 GB DRAM write buffer and 16 GiB read staging.
row.boundary_zh: 多数为single run；无写缓冲96并发会低6.7%；最大实测池4.6TB/两节点，全天保留成本是算术估计；读占主导、低负载、dense非MLA模型不可直接推广；部分补丁尚未upstream。
row.boundary_en: Most results are single runs. Without the write buffer, throughput falls 6.7% at concurrency 96. The largest measured pool is 4.6 TB across two nodes; full-day retention costs are arithmetic estimates. Read-heavy, lightly loaded and dense non-MLA workloads are not established by these results, and some patches are not upstream yet.

row.summary_zh: 10 月 20 日版本新增 GEMM/MultiHeadAttention 的 INT4/INT6/INT8 块量化、导出工具和多 CPU 后端实现。发布说明明确区分权重量化与动态激活量化。
row.summary_en: The October 20 release adds block-quantized INT4/INT6/INT8 GEMM and MultiHeadAttention, export tools and multiple CPU implementations, explicitly separating weight-only and dynamic-activation paths.
row.dependencies_zh: 块大小为 32/64/128；INT8 CPU 路径采用动态逐行/逐块激活量化、INT32 点积及逐块反量化累加。具体 ISA 与 storage 路径按后端核对。
row.dependencies_en: Block sizes are 32/64/128. The INT8 CPU path uses dynamic per-row/per-block activation quantization, INT32 dot products and per-block dequantized accumulation. ISA and storage paths vary by backend.
row.boundary_zh: INT4/INT6 为权重量化；MHA 仅量化 Q/K/V/out projection，Attention 与 KV cache 保持浮点。新 KV 布局当前 batch=1，升级不能复用旧手工/持久化 cache。版本说明未给统一质量或端到端加速比。
row.boundary_en: INT4/INT6 are weight-only. MHA quantizes Q/K/V/out projections while attention and KV caches remain floating-point. The new KV layout supports batch=1 and is incompatible with old manually constructed/persisted caches. No common quality or end-to-end speedup benchmark is supplied.
row.scope_zh: 补充端侧 CPU 低比特执行和导出边界，不把投影量化写成完整 Attention 量化。
row.scope_en: Adds edge-CPU low-bit execution and export constraints without conflating projection and complete attention quantization.
